topic: Shared banner component
decision: The banners on feature01 (1820:3053) and feature02 (1820:3097), and feature03's conclusion (1820:3142), are one shared component `banner`, node 1820:2827. feature02 and conclusion are detached copies of it in Figma; they keep their position in each page's sections but are built from the component. Rules out one banner file per page.

topic: btn-contact is button-contact
decision: The header's btn-contact (671:46) is treated as the same button as the catalogue's button-contact (1602:5418), listed once in components with design 1602:5418. Rules out a second contact-button component. Revisit if the header's button measures differently from 1602:5418.

topic: Sitemap merged from draft; SEO copy unconfirmed
decision: docs/project.json sitemap is merged unchanged from docs/project.draft.json (10 pages, 56 sections). Every title/description is the agent's draft from textSample, not the client's copy; aimes, feature01 and feature02 are the weakest. The header is a detached frame repeated on all 10 pages and only the top page's node (1517:3978) was taken; identity across pages is unchecked.

topic: No SP design: small screen is built by the agent
decision: The designer will not supply SP artboards (answers Q1 of the design analysis). No section has a designSP, so TW-25 applies to every section: the agent derives the small screen from the PC node and writes both widths in one pass, including lg:/xl:/pc: (mq() on bem). Width taken off a frame is capped, not fixed. spWidth stays 390 as the root re-anchor width only. Rules out waiting for SP frames.

topic: Noto Sans JP stands in for Avenir and Avenir Next
decision: Avenir and Avenir Next (eyebrows, numerals, header nav at 12px) have no web licence. The client chose Noto Sans JP for both, so the token step sets one family and does not bring Avenir in. Outfit, used by the numbered circles in the design, is web-licensed and is a separate question not covered here. Rules out licensing Avenir or substituting Montserrat.

topic: Header contact buttons stay in the header; D-002 superseded
decision: The header has no btn-contact instance: its two buttons (自動見積り 153x40, お問合せ 95x40) are detached rectangles and stay as the header's own markup. D-002 is superseded. Component button-contact now points at 671:46, the btn-contact the pages place; 1602:5418 is placed by no page. Rules out a shared small white button.

topic: Components merged per the design analysis
decision: banner-aimes folds into banner (1820:2827); faq-question and faq-answer into faq-item (1215:5249, open state); navigation-button01-04 into number-card (1820:3203), which the analysis also uses for faq-category-button01-04 and the four solution cards on top (17 uses). Fallback if number-card proves too varied: number-card plus solution-item. Four banner sections missing from the sitemap are added last on flow, aimes, quality and services (1820:2972, 1820:3019, 1820:2994, 1820:2961): 60 sections. Primary and Accent/Primary are both #C11C1F; tokens write one and alias the other.

topic: Design tokens named as proposed in the analysis
decision: Tokens in src/scss/foundation/_variables.scss keep the names proposed in docs/design-analysis.md section 1, no rename. Colours are literal hex in :root; the $color, $font and $text maps hold var(--...) references. Weight is recorded per style in a comment, not tokenised; line-height is not tokenised (TW-26).

topic: Primary and Accent/Primary kept as two tokens
decision: The design binds two variables (Primary, Accent/Primary) to #C11C1F, so --color-primary and --color-accent-primary both stay with the literal value. Merge only if the designer confirms they are one (analysis Q3).

topic: Unbound colours declared as tokens
decision: #F83030, #6F0103 and #E92225 have no Figma variable and are declared as --color-primary-light, --color-primary-dark and --color-header in a separate commented block (BEM-04). Move them up if the designer binds variables. Illustration-only colours are not tokens.

topic: Full Figma text set tokenised, including unused sizes
decision: --text-btn-lg and --text-btn-md exist in the design but sit on no node the analysis found. Kept because the design defines them; drop if only used tokens are wanted.

topic: Fonts: Noto Sans JP and Outfit from Google Fonts
decision: Noto Sans JP 400/500/600/700/900 and Outfit 700 load via layouts/head.ejs. Avenir and Avenir Next have no web font, so --font-en is Avenir, Avenir Next, Outfit, then Noto Sans JP; it shows Avenir only on machines that have it. Waiting on the client for a licensed web font (Q-001); changing it later is one line.

topic: Content width 1080 and rem-root divisor 39
decision: project.contentWidth is 1080 (x 180 to 1260 on the 1440 frame, from the analysis), exposed as --container-content: 108rem. The 1240px section panels (1080 plus 80px bleed each side) are section-level and not tokenised. The rem root divisor stays 39 (spWidth 390 / 10), as the starter had it.

topic: Header and footer carry no min-width; layout switches at xl
decision: TW-25 applies (no SP artboard, D-004), so header and footer own 768-1440 and have no min-width. The switch is mq("xl") (1280): at 1024 the ~770px right-hand group plus the 200px logo block does not fit. Below xl the header is two rows (logo+actions, then nav as a scrolling red strip); from xl it is the single 80px row of node 1517:3978. Footer card stacks below xl. Arithmetic is by hand, not yet measured.

topic: Header slanted block is a CSS clip-path, pills stay in header.ejs
decision: Node 1517:3980 is a polygon (M0 0H1340V100H86L0 0Z), written as clip-path on .l-header::before in --color-header, no asset. Pills 1517:3990 and 1517:3993 are plain links in header.ejs (D-006). Logo alt is FASTCODING (bitmap has no text layer). No hamburger on SP: a menu would be a client design decision.

topic: Header nav, pills, search and footer CTAs are href=# data-placeholder
decision: No design layer says where the 4 nav items, 2 pills, search icon or 2 footer CTAs point. Only the logo links to the site root. Waiting on the client for targets (Q-002). Hover states (pill bg, nav underline, search opacity, CTA arrow slide) were added by the agent as the design has none.

topic: Footer art is one whole image; the CTA plate is pseudo-elements
decision: footer-bg I1517:3603;1275:1629 has no export setting and no text, so per IMG-15 it is one decorative img (bg_footer.png) with the red also set in CSS. #6F0103 plate is ::before offset (10,10) radius 10, not box-shadow, since a shadow would inherit radius 20. TW-26 offsets at xl: title margin-top 2.125rem, lead 1.325rem, CTA title/note gap 1.625rem; verify-design will flag later lines of multi-line text, which is the rule. Node 1275:1782 returned invalid selection, instance 1517:3603 was used instead.

topic: Header below lg is a hamburger menu; supersedes the two-row strip in D-014
decision: At the user's request the header is one 56px row (logo and hamburger) below lg (1024), with the nav, the two pills and the search in a red panel dropping from it; no design node draws this, so it is derived (TW-25). From lg the wrapper .l-header__menu is display: contents and the single 80px row of D-014 is unchanged. Behaviour is headerMenu() in scripts.ts: .js-header-toggle sets .is-open on .js-header, closes on Esc, on a menu link and on resize to lg. is-open is JS-only, so audit-classes lists it as a dead block, which is expected.

topic: Hero structure, naming and shared components
decision: top/hero is section[aria-labelledby] with the page h1, a card h2 and a real form.js-form (fieldset, four form-field includes, submit). SCSS is page/index/_hero.scss, block p-index-hero (root-page table), not p-hero. Shared modules written here: breadcrumb (items), button-contact (label, href, modifier red|white), form-field (id, label, type, placeholder, name). Field ids/names are the agent's.

topic: Hero art and form illustration are single images
decision: Frames 1517:3816 (1440x634 panel) and 1517:3903 (115x106) have no export setting; per IMG-15 each is one img from the frame render, not rebuilt from layers. The panel is shown from lg only; below lg a vertical white-to-primary CSS gradient stands in (derived, TW-25). Both pending the designer (Q-003).

topic: Hero responsive layer (TW-25)
decision: No SP artboard, so no min-width. Base 390 stacks breadcrumb, text and card; md keeps the stack with wider padding; lg+ is the designed row with inline padding max(40, (100%-1080)/2) = 180 at 1440. h1 28 base, 32 lg, 45 xl; card width capped at 52rem when stacked. Breadcrumb is the one absolute (true overlay at x=100,y=96): left 20 on SP, 100 from lg.

topic: Hero line-height compensation (TW-26)
decision: Subtitle lh 1.5 with negative margins (-4.5px above, -5.5px below) so the following block keeps its place; eyebrow is nowrap lh 1 with -22px bottom margin. Card eyebrow lh 1.5 and h2 lh 1.3, glyph pitch 42.5 as designed. verify-design reports later lines of multi-line blocks as diverging by this rule.

topic: Field and shadow colours declared as tokens
decision: Hero form field border/placeholder #bbb and the card shadow rgb(0 0 0 / 25%) have no Figma variable; declared as --color-field and --color-shadow in _variables.scss per D-010, replacing the agent's stand-in of border-primary/text-secondary. Hover on the white button-contact and on the submit is derived (not drawn): invert, and opacity .8.

topic: Hero measured over the floor, not reviewed
decision: Run with --review=none: pc 7 bands over 24/255, 2090-5358 points per 100px band, built 637 vs design 634; no SP node, verify-probe at 320/375/390/768 shows no sideways scroll. Nothing marked reviewed or accepted. Expected sources: the art PNG render vs the CSS gradient, TW-26 shifts, text noise. Needs a person's look or fa-design-review.

topic: form-field is page-local
decision: form-field.ejs is used only by the root page (design-analysis catalog lists Pages = /), so it moved from common/module/ to pages/_components/ per DIR-03. Its SCSS stays in object/component/_form-field.scss.

topic: Icons exported as SVG; search icon stays PNG
decision: icn_breadcrumb_arrow.png became icn_arrow_breadcrumb.svg (node 1517:4883) and icn_download.png became icn_download.svg (node I1517:3977;672:69), both 24x24 stroked vectors. icn_search.png stays: node 1517:3983 is a raster image fill, so an SVG export only wraps the bitmap. Replace it if the designer supplies a vector.

topic: Skip link excluded from smooth scroll
decision: The skip link in layouts/head.ejs carries js-no-scroll so smoothScroll leaves it alone and the browser moves focus into main (SEM-11). Verify-probe on / at 1100/1024/1023/768 shows no sideways scroll, so the header holds at the lg switch.

topic: Project doubles as the kit's BEM test bed
decision: fcs999 is built with css=bem while the kit's BEM support is under development (kit branch feature/bem-scss). Kit rules and agent prompts are largely written in Tailwind syntax, so rules are read through the mapping table in bem-rules.md and briefs state the flavour. Any Tailwind assumption, ambiguity or contradiction met while working is a kit gap: reported to the user as a proposal and logged here as a kit-gap entry, never patched in passing. Rules out silent workarounds and unrequested kit edits.

topic: Kit renamed 'flavour' to 'method'
decision: CLAUDE.md, SCSS comments and the gulpfile copy follow kit K-60: the CSS option is the CSS method, and briefs carry a CSS method: line. project.json keeps the css field and its value bem. Earlier entries here keep the old word.
